base_member_text: [L11-L15,L18-L19] (MED/output-path) When RevisionNumber is defined the script writes version.dat in the current directory, whereas the normal and fallback paths target includes\version\version.dat, so the same script can produce metadata in different locations.
audit_member_text: [L8,L12-L15,L19] (MED/generated-file-location) The RevisionNumber branch writes version.dat in the working directory instead of includes/version/version.dat and marks success, leaving the compiler's version include stale or missing.

adversarial.rationale: The two output locations are inconsistent, but the claimed immediate stale/missing compiler include is not generally true: all consumers use bare version.dat, and the pre-build caller runs in the library source directory, where this branch creates it. Intel searches the including source directory first ([Intel include-file documentation](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/docs/fortran-compiler/developer-guide-reference/2024-2/use-include-files.html)), so the narrower defect is split metadata locations and possible stale root-file shadowing after a later build switches back to the normal/f

base_member_text: [L3-L10] (LOW/portability) Automatic version generation depends exclusively on the hard-coded TortoiseSVN executable path C:\Program Files\TortoiseSVN\bin\SubWCRev.exe, with no configurable override or alternate VCS path.

audit_member_text: [L13] (LOW/locale-dependence) Build_Date slices DATE at fixed character offsets, producing malformed dates under different Windows locale formats.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: The RevisionNumber branch takes a fixed ten-character substring starting at offset three of DATE. No locale normalization precedes it, so a date without a three-character weekday prefix loses actual date characters.

adversarial.rationale: The RevisionNumber branch directly slices DATE and TIME without establishing a locale or normalizing the date. Applying the exact character slice to representative DATE strings such as 2026-09-07 or Mon 09/07/2026 truncates the date, and no caller supplies a compensating DATE format.

audit_member_text: [L6-L15] (MED/batch-expansion) RevisionNumber is interpolated directly into an echoed Fortran literal without escaping, so quotes or command metacharacters can corrupt generation.
